paragraphs: R. Yehudah ben Lakish, tanna of a baraita: Shabbat 43b; Chagigah 9b, near the end; Yoma 53b—the new Talmud editions delete ben Lakish [the checked digital text puts it in parentheses]—and 85a. In Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel's name: Kohelet Midrash, on “What is crooked cannot be made straight.” Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel in the name of ריב״ל: Sifra, Acharei Mot, section 8. [The checked Sifra reads Shimon ben Lakish. The parallel Yalkut reads Yehudah ben Lakish.] R. Yochanan said the law follows R. Yehudah ben Lakish: Shabbat 44a. [The checked passage specifies the case of a corpse.]
